findings.title: Reject non-positive flusher process counts
findings.body: A negative `--flusher-processes` value makes `num_processes` negative, so the process map is empty and no flusher is started. The consumer can still commit spans after writing them to Redis, but nothing will flush those spans to the buffered-segments topic, eventually causing data loss. Validate that the configured count is positive instead of silently creating zero workers.
